text:
```yaml
name: Godot Addon CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Restore godot/ source directory
        run: |
          git checkout HEAD~1 -- godot/
        shell: bash

      - name: Cache ccache (Linux/macOS)
        if: ${{ matrix.os != 'windows-latest' }}
        uses: hendrikmuhs/ccache-action@v1.2
        with:
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-ccache-${{ hashFiles('**/CMakeLists.txt') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-ccache-

      - name: Setup MSBuild (Windows)
        if: ${{ matrix.os == 'windows-latest' }}
        uses: actions/setup-msbuild@v1.0.1

      - name: Build Godot Addon
        uses: lukka/run-cmake@v3
        with:
          cmakeListsOrSettingsJson: CMakeLists.txt
          cmakeListsTxtPath: .
          cmakeBuildType: Release
          cmakeGenerator: ${{ matrix.os == 'windows-latest' && 'Visual Studio 17 2022' || 'Ninja' }}
          buildDirectory: build
          cmakeAppendedArgs: -DADDON_BUILD=ON

      - name: Upload addon artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: addon-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: build/*.zip
```
